module: Entry point of the editor's "Easy Select" tool. Registers an edit mode (editor.editModes.ezObjectSelect, name "Easy Select", action map "EZObjectSelect") and a tool window, then delegates the work to editor/ezObjectSelect/controller. The cut/copy/paste/duplicate/select all/deselect/delete actions are relayed to the standard mode editor.editModes.objectSelect. The mouse wheel shortcuts are documented: Ctrl+wheel cycles overlapping objects, Shift+wheel rotates the selection around world Z (Ctrl+Shift: in 1 degree steps).
notes: If activating the controller fails, the mode returns to editModes.objectSelect on the next frame.
Several hooks (object added, prefab exploded, inspector fields modified) invalidate the selection cache if the controller is active.
The request* functions do nothing if the Easy Select mode is not the active mode.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Loads the preferences, resets the input filters, registers the window (390x460 x uiscale) and the edit mode.

onEditorGui.desc: If the mode is active, draws the screen debug and the workspace window (controller.drawWorkspace).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Loads the preferences and resets the input filters.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Leaves the mode (back to objectSelect) or deactivates the controller, then unregisters the window and the mode.

requestTransformShortcut.desc: Requests the transform (move) operation via keyboard shortcut.

requestRotateShortcut.desc: Requests the rotate operation via shortcut.

requestScaleShortcut.desc: Requests the scale operation via shortcut.

requestFocusShortcut.desc: Requests centering the camera on the selection (focus).

requestNumpadPreset.desc: Forwards a numpad key to the controller (view preset).

preset.desc: Preset (inferred from code: value forwarded as-is)

onEditorObjectAdded.desc: Hook: invalidates the selection cache (reason objectAdded).

onEditorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook: for gizmos.general.highlightSelectedMeshes refreshes the selection tint if the mode is active; otherwise relays to the controller.

onEditorAxisGizmoModeChanged.desc: Hook: relays the axis gizmo mode change to the controller if the mode is active.

onEditorAxisGizmoAligmentChanged.desc: Hook (game spelling "Aligment"): relays the gizmo alignment change.

onEditorRegisterPreferences.desc: Hook: lets the controller save its preferences.
